Commentary.Commentary: Right then! After a total drubbing in the Tests, Sri Lanka have bounced back in the T20Is to win the series. Arguably, mostly due to South Africa's complacency but then they will take it. The two teams now lock horns in a 5-match ODI series starting from Saturday, 28th January, 2017 at 1000 local (0800 GMT) in Port Elizabeth. The Lankans definitely have the momentum but expect the Proteas to bounce back like a wounded lion. ADIOS! TAKE CARE!

Sri Lanka skipper, Dinesh Chandimal says that after a poor result in the Tests, they wanted to get back to winning ways. They did that in the 2nd T20I and wanted to take the momentum into the third. Praises Dickwella and Sandakan for their performances in the whole series. Also acknowledges the performance of Mathews in the second T20I. Appreciates today's performances of Prasanna and Gunaratne. Ends by saying that he is looking forward for the one-dayers.

Man of the Match and Man of the Series, Niroshan Dickwella says it's his first time in South Africa and it felt great to play under these conditions. He says that he wanted to take advantage of the first six overs and then bat as long as possible for his team. He adds that he likes to play according to his strength on being asked about his cheeky shots. Appreciates the South African wickets as they were good batting tracks. Ends by saying that he is happy as he did his job for his team.

South Africa skipper Farhaan Behardien feels that they had enough on board. He says the camp wanted to do better with the bat after the 2nd T20I. Blames those dropped catches which proved costly. Also feels that losing Ngidi was a huge blow as they had to fill in his overs. Praises Tahir for his performance but says that it didn't prove to be enough for them to get over the line. Ends by saying it was tough to lose in front of a packed Newlands crowd and will now change their attention to the ODIs.

Like the Lankans, the Proteas too bowled inconsistently. Ngidi and Paterson started well but then the former had an injury and could not bowl his entire quota of 4 overs while Paterson went for a lot in the death overs. Wayne Parnell was the unluckiest of the bowlers, with three dropped catches coming of his own bowling while Tahir was brilliant again, with 3/18 in 4 overs. Phehlukwayo was poor tonight. Stay tuned for the presentation.

They say, in a T20 game, one moment is enough to change the momentum. South Africa were abysmal in the field tonight. As many as five catches were put down with three going down in succession and if that was not enough, Imran Tahir misjudged an easy chance of Seekkuge Prasanna when he was only on 2. He ended up on an unbeaten 37 from 16 balls and that moment on 16.2 swung the series Sri Lanka's way.

Tharanga and Chandimal departed in quick succession but the 71-run stand in 61 balls for the third wicket between Dickwella and Dhananjaya de Silva gave nervous moments to the Proteas. Then, came those two magical overs - First, Phehlukwayo bowled a wonderful 2-run over in the 15th and then the pressure led to the wickets of the two set batsmen in the next over from Tahir. South Africa were back on top, with the Lankans needing 52 from 24 balls.

We mentioned during the innings break that if Dickwella got going, you never know. He did get going. He got off to a racy start but then struggled in the middle overs. But as long as he was there, the Lankans were in chance of a win.
Phew! What a game. Fully filled of twists and turns till that final over. In the end, Sri Lanka prevailed as the Proteas choked.

That is the game! Comes down the track again, Paterson bowls it on a length outside off, Gunaratne gets to the pitch of the ball and eases it through cover-point for the winning run! This time Gunaratne crosses for the single, uproots the stumps at the bowler's end and then roars in triumph. What a run chase. SRI LANKA WIN BY 5 WICKETS AND TAKE THE SERIES 2-1!

TOP EDGE, FOUR! That levels the scores! A length ball outside off, Gunaratne comes down the track and swings hard but gets a top edge which sails over the keeper to the third man fence! Drama prevails as Gunaratne uproots the off stump and celebrates but then the square leg umpire tells him that the game is not over yet! Prasanna apologizes on Gunaratne's behalf but Behardien is not too happy.
A conference is going on out there. As many as 4 players are giving advice to the bowler. Too many cooks spoiling the broth?
Full and outside off, Prasanna swings hard and gets a thick inside edge onto his pads. Went too hard there. The ball goes towards point and the batsmen take a run. 5 NEEDED FROM 3 BALLS.
Behardien has a long chat with his bowler. No field change.
Comes down the track and blasts it over covers for a single. 6 needed from 4 balls now.
FOUR! Lovely shot! Full and outside off, Gunaratne gets across and paddles it over short fine leg for a boundary! 7 NEEDED FROM 5 BALLS!
DANE PATERSON to bowl the final over. Sri Lanka need 11 for a win. 10 for a Super Over.

FOUR! Ho ho ho! Cheeky! Prasanna looks to play the paddle scoop by getting across and on seeing that, the bowler bowls it wide outside off. What does the batsman do? Keeps the bat as it is and just angles it to scoop the ball over the right side of the keeper instead! 15 from the over, Phehlukwayo goes for 32 in his 4 overs!
Another dot! Full and outside off, almost the yorker again, Prasanna swings but misses again!
Excellent comeback from the bowler. Yorker length, outside off, SP looks to force it through the off side but loses his bat instead which goes near square leg.
WIDE! That helps. Phehlukwayo bowls this miles outside off and Seekkuge cannot reach.

SIX! ADMONISHED! How well is that hit? A length ball outside off, Prasanna jumps down the track and swats it miles over long on! No one is catching that for sure! Reaches his best score in T20Is. 16 needed from 9 balls now. The stand is worth 12 from 6 balls.
Short and outside off, Gunaratne swings hard and gets a bottom edge towards mid-wicket. A run taken.
Third man comes up and fine leg goes back for Gunaratne.
Full toss outside off, slashed away behind point. The fielder gets a hand to it and prevents the boundary. Three runs taken by the time third man can get across.
ANDILE PHEHLUKWAYO to bowl the 19th over.
Driven towards the mid off region. The batsmen have run through for a single.
The batsman has driven it through mid on.
Full and outside off, Gunaratne looks to paddle but misses. He is hit on the pads and Paterson appeals for LBW but in vain. A leg bye taken.
ASELA GUNARATNE walks in at number 7, replacing Mendis.

OUT! Mendis is well short. Around off, Prasanna looks to push it to the off side but gets an under edge. Mendis goes for the run but as an afterthought. Paterson gets to the ball quickly and has a shy at the striker's end and hits the stumps. The LED bails glow and the umpire refers it upstairs. Replays show that Mendis' dive is not enough to save him.
Direct hit! Is Kusal Mendis gone? Referred upstairs...
FOUR! Fine shot! Prasanna is keeping the Lankans in the game. On middle and off, Prasanna gets across and whips it over square leg for a boundary! 28 needed from 16 balls now!
Full and wide outside off, slapped down to long off for a single.
DANE PATERSON to bowl the 18th over.

SIX! That extra ball hurts Parnell! A length ball on middle, Prasanna is early into his swing, but still the ball goes off the middle of the bat, high in the air and soars over deep square leg! 19 from the over! 33 needed from 18 balls. This game ain't over yet.
WIDE. Banged in short around middle, Seekkuge goes for the hook but misses. He straightaway looks at the square leg umpire in anticipation of a wide and gets it.
SIX! No catching this one! A short ball down the leg side, Prasanna helps it over fine leg and the ball goes all the way!

CATCHING CHANCE MISSED! FOUR! Terrible misjudgement from Tahir. A length ball outside off, Prasanna swings hard but gets a mighty top edge. The ball goes towards third man but Tahir comes charging in from the boundary. Then, he realizes that he has come in too much and stops. Turns back but the ball is already beyond him. Bounces and crosses the ropes.
Outside off, Seekkuge swings but misses.
On a good length on middle and off, Mendis is squared up and the ball goes off the outside edge past the keeper to third man. A run taken.

TERRIFIC EFFORT FROM HEINO KUHN! You can put it as a dropped catch if you want but South Africa will look at it as five runs saved. A length ball on middle, Prasanna swings hard and gets a good connection. It seems like the ball will clear the ropes but Kuhn at deep square leg waits for the ball, then leaps and pushes the ball back into play. Just a single!
WAYNE PARNELL is back on.
The batsman was beaten and missed the line of the delivery. What a spell from Tahir - 4-0-18-3!
KUSAL MENDIS is the new man in at number 6, replacing Dhananjaya.

OUT! Stumped! De Silva has been put out of his misery. Beautifully flighted outside off, sees the batsman jump out and slows the pace and bowls it slightly wide outside off. De Silva just through with the shot is comprehensively beaten. So far down the track is he that the keeper Mosehle can wait for a second and then whip the bails off. Getting tougher for the Lankans now. 52 NEEDED FROM 25 BALLS.
Full on middle and leg, flicked through mid-wicket for a single.
A full toss on middle, de Silva swings hard but gets it off the inner half of the bat through mid-wicket. A single taken.
SEEKKUGE PRASANNA walks in at number 5, replacing Dickwella.

OUT! Caught! That over from Phehlukwayo has done the trick. Pressure was being built and Dickwella is gone now. Full and around middle, Dickwella looks to slog it over mid-wicket but he has to reach out for it and ends up holing it to Farhaan Behardien at deep mid-wicket. A wonderful innings from Dickwella has been cut short. SRI LANKA still need 54 from 28 balls.
A ridiculous LBW appeal. A googly outside leg, Dickwella looks to sweep but misses. The ball hits his pads and the bowler and keeper appeal, but the impact was well outside leg too!
IMRAN TAHIR into the attack now. He is bowling out.
Another dot ball! Outstanding stuff from Phehlukwayo! Another short ball, angling into the batsman, Dhananjaya hooks but misses! Just 2 runs from the over!
Backs away to the leg side again and Phehlukwayo bowls it wide outside off. Niroshan slashes hard but misses. This time the batsmen take a bye.
ANOTHER DOT! Sees Dickwella charge out and bangs in a slower bouncer. Dickwella jumps and tries to cut but bottom edges it back to the bowler.
Backs away to the leg side, Phehlukwayo follows him. ND tries to paddle scoop but misses.
A quicker one around off, short in length, Niroshan looks to pull but the ball comes on quicker than his anticipation and it goes off his elbow to cover.

A short ball on middle and off, de Silva looks to pull but gets a thick inside edge onto his body. He is searching for the ball but Dickwella calls him through for a quick single. Phehlukwayo quickly gets to the ball but while trying to pick it up, he runs into de Silva and loses it. He is angry with the batsman for coming in his way but that was not de Silva's mistake.
ANDILE PHEHLUKWAYO is back on. South Africa need a wicket or two.
DID THAT CARRY? Not according to Mike Haysman on air. Short and outside off, Dickwella cuts it uppishly and the ball seemingly lands in front of Wayne Parnell at point.
A short ball, pulled towards deep mid-wicket for one more.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. One run added to the total.

SIX! This is even better! He is toying with JJ here. Floated on middle ad leg, Dickwella jumps down the track again and swings this cleanly over mid-wicket! Goes all the way! 58 more needed from 39 balls now.

FOUR! Lovely shot. Tossed up on middle and leg, Dickwella comes down the track and whips it through mid-wicket for a boundary! Moves to 61 from 42 balls with his 10th boundary. The stand is worth 61 from 49 balls.
Full and outside leg, Dickwella looks to play the reverse sweep but misses and is hit on the back side.
The batsman paddles the ball down the leg side. One run added to the total.
Backs away and slashes hard to a length ball outside off and misses.

Well, strange shot. Full and around leg stump, ND looks to play the paddle but the ball goes off the top edge and lands near fine leg. Two more to the total. 100 UP FOR SRI LANKA! They are on course for a series win. 69 more needed from 44 balls.
Banged in short, Niroshan pulls it towards deep mid-wicket. Dane Paterson covers long yards running to his right in the deep and dives to stop the ball. Two runs taken.
Chips this towards long on and gets a run.
Full and outside off, Dickwella backs away and slices his attempted loft towards long off. The ball goes not carry. A single taken.
WAYNE PARNELL is back on.
50-run stand is up in 41 balls.
The batsman works it down the leg side. They pick up a single. 10 from the over.
Now he gets to his MAIDEN T20I FIFTY. Comes down the track and just tucks this through mid-wicket. Charges back and completes a well-run second. Excellent running.

FOUR! Nicely done! Landed outside off, Dickwella brings out his reverse sweep and gets it over short third man for a boundary! He is playing with his luck here, Dickwella. Fortune favours the brave. Reaches his highest T20I score.
Comes down the track but is not to the pitch of the ball. Still, he swings his bat and gets it through mid-wicket for one.
Landed on middle and leg, Dickwella swings it towards deep square leg. Dane Paterson comes running in from the ball lands just short of him. A run taken.
Full and around off, swung towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
JJ SMUTS comes on to bowl now.
Almost drags it on! On a length outside off, de Silva looks to play it with a horizontal bat but gets it off the under edge past the stumps to fine leg for a single.
Fuller on middle and leg, driven to long on for a single.
In the air... but lands safely! Fullish outside off, de Silva reaches for it and lofts it over mid on. De Villiers at long on runs towards the ball but it falls short of him. A single is taken!
De Silva charges down, Phehlukwayo angles it in, beats de Silva. Gets it off the thigh pad to the keeper.
Outside off, de Silva looks to go big but ends up swinging his bat in the air.
Slow bouncer, ND waits and waits for it and then drags it through square leg for a single.
Short outside off, Dickwella camps back and punches it through covers for a single.
This time de Silva shuffles and paddles it over the stumps for a single.
Fuller on middle and leg, flicked through mid-wicket for a single.
That's risky! Straighter one, Dickwella gives himself room and defends it very late behind square on the off side.
FOUR! Tossed up on middle and off, Dickwella gets across a touch, kneels down and paddles it fine down the leg side for a boundary. Great shot especially the placement!
Sliding into the pads, played through mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Fine shot! Short again from Phehlukwayo, outside off, Dickwella leaps a touch and slaps it over point for another boundary! 13 from the over!
Full on middle, ND looks to flick but misses and is it on the pads. No appeal made from the bowler, perhaps an inside edge was involved.
FOUR! That is a nice way of giving advice to the bowler! Short and outside off, Dickwella flays it over point and gets a boundary!

MASSIVE APPEAL FOR A CAUGHT BEHIND. The umpire shakes his head. The Proteas do not like it. A short ball outside off, Niroshan slashes hard but misses. There is a noise as the ball goes past the bat and Mangaliso Mosehle straightway throws the ball up in celebration as soon as he takes it. Phehlukwayo puts in a loud appeal, prolongs it but the umpire is firm. The bowler then has a chat with the batsman, asking him whether he edged it nor not. Then Parnell comes in from somewhere and gives Dickwella a piece of his mind. Snickometer shows nothing.

FOUR! Cheeky! A left-hand version of the Dilscoop. Dickwella gets low and across to his left, takes it on the full and scoops it right over the keeper to the fence behind! The stand moves to 20 from 19 balls.
Full and down the leg side, de Silva misses his flick and the ball goes off his pads towards fine leg. Leg bye signalled. 109 more needed from 71 balls now.
ANDILE PHEHLUKWAYO comes on to bowl now.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot on the leg side. The batsmen have run through for a single.

Tossed up outside off, de Silva takes the aerial route. Doesn't get it off the middle of the bat. AB from long on runs and dives but the ball lands just short. The long off fielder then cuts it out and keeps it to a brace.
Tossed up outside off, pushed to covers.
Sliding into the pads, clipped through mid-wicket for a brace.
The batsman has driven that ball straight back to the bowler.
Outside off, spinning away, guided to short third man.

Hat-trick of drops! Back of a length delivery, Dickwella looks to flat bat it straight down the ground but mistimes it. Parnell jumps to his highest, gets finger to it but he too can't hold onto it. Luck combined with poor fielding is the story of the innings so far!

FOUR! Dropped another one! What's going on out there? This time it's the keeper! Short and angling down leg, Dickwella looks to pull it but gets it off the gloves. Mosehle behind the stumps jumps, gets a glove to it but fails to hold onto it. That's really poor from a keeper. The ball reaches the fence behind!
DROPPED! Short again, de Silva pulls it over fine leg. Paterson gets under it but puts it down. A single is taken!
Back of a length outside off, Dickwella gives himself room and guides it uppishly on one bounce to Paterson in the deep for a single.
Length delivery, angling in, defended off the back foot.
Outside off, guided through to third man for a single.
The batsman plays a pull shot to this short delivery. One run added to the total.
Short delivery, sliding in, de Silva misses his flick and is struck on the thigh-pad.
Full on middle and off, driven to mid on.
On the pads, worked down the leg side for a single.
Spinning away from outside off, de Silva guides it behind square on the off side for a single.
DHANANJAYA DE SILVA walks in at number 4, replacing Chandimal.

OUT! Tahir too strikes with his first ball! Quicker and straighter, Chandimal dances down the track and is completely beaten by the quicker one first up. The ball goes through from between his bat and pad and goes onto hit the leg stump. Tahir is delighted and runs the lap. The skipper has to depart and Sri Lanka still need 125 runs off 89 deliveries with 8 wickets in hand!
IMRAN TAHIR into the attack now.
FOUR! Dickwella gives himself cover and lofts it over point. Superb shot and earns a boundary for that!
Full outside off, gently pushed through mid off for a quick single.
The physio is out in the middle. Ngidi looks to be in a lot of pain.

Full outside off, Chandimal drives it sweetly on the up through cover-point. Ngidi present there, dives to his left but fails to stop the ball cleanly. Another couple taken. Ngidi seems to have hurt himself on that dive and is still lying on the ground. He is clutching his left side.

DROPPED! Banged in short, Chandimal goes for the pull but gets it off the top edge miles in the air. It's swirling as it comes down and as Tahir comes in from third man, fails to gets under it and ends up dropping it. The batsmen pick up a couple off it!
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
DINESH CHANDIMAL walks in at number 3, replacing Tharanga.

OUT! PARNELL STRIKES! Back of a length delivery outside off, Tharanga looks to pull it but checks his shot at the last moment. A half-hearted flat bat shot gets straight to Behardien at mid on. The skipper holds onto it and Tharanga has to walk back! The on-air commentator, Kepler Wessels, just said that Parnell was having an off first spell in the series and he has done exactly the opposite here.
WAYNE PARNELL is the first bowling change.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Tharanga looks to pull it over mid-wicket but mistimes it. Falls short of Hendricks. A single is taken! SL riding their luck!
Wide! Short down the leg side, UT looks to pull it but misses. A wide is signalled.
FOUR! On a length and outside off, Tharanga deliberately edges it through gully for a boundary. Back-to-back boundaries for Tharanga!
FOUR! On the pads, UT clips it over backward square leg for a boundary.
Full outside off, driven through widish mid off. The extra-cover fielder parries it towards mid off and a single is taken.
Back of a length delivery outside off, cut to point.

DROPPED! On the pads, Tharanga glances it on its way. It's off the middle of the bat. Ngidi at short fine leg gets low to his left, gets hand to it but fails to hold onto it. A single is taken off the drop.
On the pads, flicked straight to the fielder on the leg side.
Back of a length delivery, ND looks to cut it but only manages a bottom edge.

FOUR! Unfortunate for the bowler! Length delivery angling in, Dickwella who backs away is cramped for room, he looks to cut it but gets a bottom edge. The ball goes from just over the stumps, beats the keeper to his right and gets to the fence.
Short delivery, Tharanga misitmes his pull over square leg. There's Smuts present there and only a single is taken.
Bye! Wide outside off, Dickwella gives himself room and has a wild swing at it but misses. Mosehle behind the stumps fails to gather cleanly and they pick up a bye.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Dickwella gets it off the toe end of the bat back to the bowler.
FOUR! Short delivery, pulled through square leg. Phehlukwayo chases it but the ball beats him to the fence.
FOUR! Full and angling in, whipped over wide mid on for a boundary. Superb wrist work there!
Fullish outside off, driven to AB at mid off. Hurls an unnecessary throw at the bowler's end but misses.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Full around off, turned through widish mid on for a single.

Full outside off, pushed through widish mid off. AB is the man present there, who gets across quickly. Tharanga from the bowler's end is halfway down the track but his partner isn't interested and sends him back. AB hurls a throw at the bowler's end but misses. Tharanga is furious as there was an easy single on offer.
DANE PATERSON to bowl from the other end!
On a length and outside off, guided through to third man for a single.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
FOUR! Fullish outside off, Dickwella gives himself room and lofts it over cover-point for a boundary.
Short delivery, pulled over backward square leg for a brace.
Back of a length delivery on the pads, worked through square leg for a single.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Dickwella looks to play it across the line but the ball goes off his hips to third man. A single taken, leg bye signalled.

We are back for the chase. NIROSHAN DICKWELLA and UPUL THARANGA to open the batting. LUNGI NGIDI to start the proceedings with the ball. 170 needed to win. Set to be an interesting end to the series. Here we go...
